verdicts.PASS: Frozen specification explicitly covers the material distinction inside claimed scope and determines a reviewable decision-level qualification/disposition consistent with evaluator facts, without inventing external-owner facts.
verdicts.FAIL: Inside claimed scope, candidate produces or claims a contrary/prohibited closure, omits a material distinction while claiming determined closure, or blocks a legitimate continuity case through a blanket rule.
verdicts.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Frozen candidate does not determine the requested property because it is external-owner/outside claimed scope, wording/maturity is insufficient, facts are missing, execution/compliance is external, or the observation boundary is indistinguishable.

acceptance_preconditions: Eligible blind/independent reader seals BR-01…BR-17 before inspecting author predictions/adjudications.
Mutation contract is executed against base candidate and M-01…M-10.
All registered mutants are killed at one or more registered kill cases.
NOT_ESTABLISHED outcomes are preserved where preregistered or independently adjudicated.
Disagreements follow DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED / third-review or successor-version rule.
No Stage-B architecture mechanism is credited as Stage-A evidence.
